D'après le code et les données du jeu. C: Based on the game's code and data. Each player gets their own share of every chest. The boss chest opens once 3 portals are closed, and each further tier adds a bonus chest or a guaranteed reward.
D'après les données et le code du jeu. L: From the game's data and code. The end chest gives one of the boss's weapons (picked at random) and Spark shards depending on your level. Each player also gets a guaranteed faction armor piece: in Normal and Veteran a rare one, drawn evenly among those their class can wear (the last 2 received are left out), in Heroic an epic one, among the boss's for their class. With 3 players one more piece is given at random, 2 with 4 players. Each piece has a 10% chance to be Prismatic (15% with the Soulwell offering). The boss's death can also give a rare item and, in Heroic, always gives the dungeon's Infusion pattern. "Obtained" counts what your runs brought back in this difficulty.
